text: いい　ものに　のってるわね　かったら　わたしに　ちょうだい！

structure.jp: いい　ものに　のってるわね
structure.en: that's a nice thing you're riding, isn't it

structure.jp: わたしに　ちょうだい！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: のってる is a short spoken form of のっている, which says the action is going on now. のってる = 'you are riding'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb says 'if that happens'. かったら = 'if I win'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of speaking, and ね asks for agreement. のってるわね = 'you're riding it, aren't you'.
